one_liner: Big-hearted festival girl who can't ignore anyone in trouble and wants every race to be a matsuri.
personality: Cheerful, earnest and sturdy, she sees herself as 'Otasuke Kita-chan' (Helper Kita-chan) and helps everyone, even when it makes her nearly late. She grew up in a lively 30-person household with her father's disciples, sings to show gratitude like her father, and drops into festival chants (wasshoi, seiya soiya) when she gets fired up. She idolises Tokai Teio and is inseparable from her childhood friend Satono Diamond. When she's off form she still refuses to lose in spirit.

story_arc.summary: Kitasan joins Tracen dreaming of being a star like Tokai Teio, and her trainer scouts her (the detail that she had lost a mock race first is not on the cited page; model knowledge, unverified). Her early events cover bonds with Diamond and Cheval, and 'the Empress's bloodline' (a rival who, per the web, is Brusquement, a Duramente stand-in). After that rival's Satsuki shock, Kitasan wins her first big festival at the Kikuka Sho. Her senior year covers the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring and a muddy Autumn), Takarazuka and Japan Cup, and ends with an Arima Kinen of 'smile fireworks' and going beyond her idol.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Kitasan_Black (Brusquement as Duramente stand-in, Team Spica); model knowledge (unverified) for the scouting detail
